findings.description: The guard changed from `if fg is not None:` to `if fg:`, so the valid palette index 0 (black) is now treated as no color and silently dropped.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller runs style(text, fg=0), which is a valid 256-color index. Mechanism: `if fg:` evaluates 0 as falsy, so no escape code is emitted. Impact: the text is printed without the requested color, with no error. The same falsy check at line 684 drops bg=0 in the same way.
